purpose: Connect airport workers to vanpool opportunities without copying or exposing private GCO member data.

platform_behavior: Show vanpool as a recommended mode for long-distance and off-hour commute gaps.
Match only Airport Employee Community Platform members who explicitly opt in.
Send interested members to GCO or Commute with Enterprise to join or formally create a vanpool.
Store no GCO credentials and import no GCO member profiles without a written data-sharing agreement.

prohibited_initial_integration: Scraping authenticated MyGCO member or match data
Publishing names, home addresses, schedules, or existing vanpool rosters
Representing synthetic matches as active GCO vanpools
future_partnership_path: Request an employer or airport-worksite partnership with Georgia Commute Options.
Ask whether a documented referral, aggregate match, or approved API/data export is available.
Use consent-based account linking only if GCO provides a supported authorization method.
